purpose: Acquire additional auditable historical source packages for independent V4 re-ingestion; this request is not an archive approval and does not authorize training.

priority_date_buckets.known_candidate_basis: Historical Library material was reported as containing original screenshot paths and per-market visible times.
priority_date_buckets.requested_output: Original official screenshot/source bytes plus auditable metadata and separate post-match labels.

priority_date_buckets.known_candidate_basis: Historical Library material was reported as containing 10 complete matches with SPF, handicap, score, total goals, and HTFT coverage.
priority_date_buckets.requested_output: Prefer complete cards with all four engine roles represented.

priority_date_buckets.known_candidate_basis: Historical Library material was reported as containing official score, total-goals, and HTFT odds with source/capture metadata.
priority_date_buckets.requested_output: Prioritize records with explicit official source identity and pre-match availability time.

priority_date_buckets.known_candidate_basis: Historical Library material was reported as containing 16 matches with lottery odds, total-goals, HTFT, and an official screenshot source declaration.
priority_date_buckets.requested_output: Prefer broad market coverage and raw source bytes over prior structured summaries.

priority_date_buckets.known_candidate_basis: Search the complete late-August Library range for distinct matches not already present in R001.
priority_date_buckets.requested_output: Fill class-support gaps after deterministic identity mapping; do not select by a predicted outcome.

priority_date_buckets.known_candidate_basis: Search reported September Library material only when the source was available before each match kickoff and the observation can be independently audited.
priority_date_buckets.requested_output: Use as later temporal buckets only after earlier buckets and cutoff semantics are proven.

quantity_targets.allocation_rule: Chronological, match-grouped temporal allocation after eligibility; no random split and no class-targeted leakage.

provenance_rules.v3_reingestion: V3-era raw factual source or prior structured extraction may be a candidate, but must be independently re-ingested under V4 contracts.
provenance_rules.timestamp_semantics: Preserve created/upload/source/capture/publication/observed/ingested timestamps separately; UNKNOWN is valid, substitution is forbidden.
provenance_rules.identity: Canonical match identity must be explicit and deterministically hashable; display-name similarity cannot resolve identity.
provenance_rules.labels: Post-match final_result, halftime_result, and derived labels are stored separately from pre-match odds/features.
provenance_rules.cutoff: Every pre-match source used by a sample must have source availability at or before prediction_cutoff_at, which precedes kickoff_at.
provenance_rules.market_unavailability: Missing SPF/RQSPF/TOTAL_GOALS/HTFT remains explicit UNAVAILABLE or NOT_VERIFIED; odds are never guessed.

class_support_priority.reason: Nine classes dominate the 99-match joint lower bound; acquire complete HTFT cards first.
Eight classes require 88 eligible samples; retain explicit 7+ tail labels.
Three-class roles require 33 samples each; keep RQSPF cutoff/line evidence separate from SPF.
After ingestion, use actual class counts to identify shortages; never choose source files using V4 predictions or probabilities.

package_requirements.dedupe_key: raw bytes + external source identity + canonical match identity + observation timestamp + extracted market payload
package_requirements.archive_write: FORBIDDEN until the real package validates and separate intake authorization exists
